profile.summary: Monopoly-like supplier of EUV lithography systems used in advanced semiconductor manufacturing.
profile.business_model: Sells lithography systems, installed-base services and upgrades to leading logic and memory manufacturers.
profile.key_thesis: Critical equipment bottleneck for advanced semiconductor scaling.

analyst_view.preliminary_view: High-quality equipment franchise with strategic scarcity value. Valuation depends on semiconductor capex recovery and the pace of next-generation EUV adoption.
